card.name: Adverb endings of route words
card.fires_on: The closing piece of an adverb in drug-label instructions, such as -ally or -ely in intracavernosally, intralesionally, systemically and closely. Also fires on the word prior before 'to treatment'.

modes.label: Route adverb endings
modes.description: The final piece of an administration-route adverb, mainly -ally after a long medical stem.
modes.example: inject CAVERJECT IMPULSE intracavernos<<ally>> and monitor patients

modes.label: Other adverb endings
modes.description: Endings of adverbs like closely or systemically in instructions and pharmacology text.

modes.label: Prior before to
modes.description: The word prior placed before 'to treatment'.
modes.example: marked elevations in liver-associated tests<< prior>> to treatment, may be at increased risk
